name: BH1750
description: ROHM BH1750FVI — digital ambient light sensor, outputs lux value directly over I2C.

alternatives.how: Connect ADDR pin to VCC (3.3V) to select 0x5C

pins.name: ADDR
pins.notes: Address select: tie to GND (or leave floating) for 0x23; tie to VCC for 0x5C. Never wired to an ESP32 GPIO.

notes: 3.3V device. ADDR pin to GND (or left floating) gives address 0x23; ADDR to VCC gives 0x5C. The sensor supports up to 120 klux with high-resolution mode 2 (180 ms integration time). Pull-ups on SDA/SCL usually provided by the breakout board.
